items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And the old man was just about ready but just before he hired George Wettling, he was talking to me.

ctx.x: He was the last of the fixers of us. So about that time, the one thing that I wanted more than anything in the world was to go with Whiteman's band. On drums. And the old man was just about ready but just before he hired George Wettling, he was talking to me. And then he found out that I was... Found out that I was going with the camera. And he...
Are you the same cat I let out? Do you want to go outside?
